item.description:
HedgeMind
RT @CBSNews: Asked whether former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang deserves a second chance after saying he would be honored to return to the company, California Gov. Gavin Newsom called the allegations against Huang “incredibly concerning,” but said, “Until we know all of that, I would reserve judgment.”

“I don't think it's right for any of us to assume any of us know the facts,” Newsom told CBS News during a visit to Capitol Hill on Tuesday.

item.description:
阳光财经
英伟达盘后财报超过预期，营业收入是1158.4亿美元，超过预期的1093亿。每股收益是2.68美元，预期是2.47美元。公司营收较去年同期的570亿美元增长超过一倍，这表明其核心数据中心业务持续强劲。四季度营收将增长约90%，达到1300亿美元，因此新一季度的营收预期也超过了分析师的预期。
下面就等5点的电话会议了，克雷斯给力点吧。
